about: The uid the events about a pod carry, as both halves read it: `events_uid` in src/tauri/src/resources/types/pod.rs and `eventsUidIn` in src/ui/hooks/useReadUid.ts. The kubelet knows a static pod by a hash of its manifest and records its events under that hash; the API server's mirror of the pod has a uid of its own and carries the hash in `kubernetes.io/config.mirror`, which is what `kubectl describe pod` searches events by. An event search by `metadata.uid` finds nothing for every control-plane pod of a kubeadm or kind cluster.

cases.name: a pod's events carry its own uid
a static pod's carry the hash in its mirror annotation
an empty mirror annotation names no hash
a pod read without a uid has none
